messages.subject: Dr R Whitmore — Without Prejudice — best and final
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Eleanor,

Our without-prejudice letter is attached. Our client's best and final position is a total termination payment of £185,000 (first £30,000 tax free) plus £5,000 plus VAT towards your client's legal fees, in full and final settlement, no admission of liability. Open until 5pm on 20 March.

Kind regards,
Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
